route_control_point: NGL gathering processing fractionation pipelines storage and export terminals
immediate_payer: shippers processors exporters and commodity customers under contracts and tariffs
main_burden_carrier: growth capex debt project execution throughput counterparties and partnership claims
current_evidence: Q2 2026 adjusted EBITDA 5.07B; DCF 2.59B; unused facility 3.76B; Nederland 240000 bpd ethane plus 55000 bpd LPG; Lone Star increment over 90000 bpd
qoe_or_shenanigans_test: reconcile tariff and contract terms to billed volume utilization shipper commitments customer credit and settlement; separate growth and maintenance capex
owner_cash_denominator: distributable cash after maintenance and growth capex debt partnership claims taxes project funding and counterparties
valuation_and_macro_boundary: price must assume throughput utilization and contracted cash; stress rates commodity volumes export constraints and project delay
thesis_breaker: growth capex and capacity rise without billed throughput utilization project contribution or DCF after claims

route_control_point: liquefaction trains and contracted LNG export capacity
immediate_payer: long-term LNG buyers cargo purchasers and project-finance cash flows
main_burden_carrier: train construction debt gas procurement maintenance customer credit and completion risk
current_evidence: FY2025 670 cargoes and 2424 TBtu; Q2 2026 184 cargoes; about 90% anticipated production contracted; FY2025 growth capex 2.6B; total debt 23.0B
qoe_or_shenanigans_test: separate cargoes contracts gas cost train completion sustaining capital debt service and customer settlement; do not treat cargo count as train return
owner_cash_denominator: cash after gas procurement train maintenance debt service sustaining capital completion cost customer credit taxes and common claims
valuation_and_macro_boundary: price must assume contracted volume and train return; stress gas rates cargo delays customer credit and capital markets
thesis_breaker: cargoes and contracts rise while train completion gas cost debt service or sustaining capital weaken cash conversion

route_control_point: refinery conversion of crude and feedstock into usable fuels
immediate_payer: fuel and product buyers wholesalers and market customers
main_burden_carrier: crude cost crack spreads turnarounds outages working capital debt and environmental claims
current_evidence: H1 2026 OCF 1.2651B; PP&E 476.5M; turnaround 242.4M; Q2 throughput 887.3 thousand bpd; H1 gross refining margin 2.9263B excluding special items; 500M 2034 note refinancing
qoe_or_shenanigans_test: separate throughput crack spread inventory insurance turnaround working capital refinery maintenance debt and refinancing; normalize special items
owner_cash_denominator: refinery cash after crude feedstock turnaround environmental working capital insurance debt taxes and replacement capital
valuation_and_macro_boundary: price must assume normalized crack spread throughput and asset life; stress margins outages rates crude basis and customer demand
thesis_breaker: throughput and margin weaken while turnaround insurance working capital refinancing and environmental capital consume cash

route_control_point: upstream production acreage reserves and depletion replacement
immediate_payer: refiners marketers commodity buyers and energy markets
main_burden_carrier: drilling and development capex production decline commodity prices LOE merger integration debt and payouts
current_evidence: H1 2026 OCF 5.329B; capex 2.157B; property/equipment acquisitions 2.919B; debt repayment 500M; Coterra merger cash acquired 581M; liquidity 4.0B
qoe_or_shenanigans_test: separate production realized price hedges LOE decline capex acquired cash treasury drawdown merger synergy debt and payouts; build commodity-stress FCF
owner_cash_denominator: cash after decline replacement capex LOE acquisitions merger integration debt taxes hedges and payouts
valuation_and_macro_boundary: price must assume reserve-backed production and stress FCF; stress commodity prices rates decline geopolitics and acquisition funding
thesis_breaker: production decline and commodity stress overwhelm capex merger contribution debt service and payout coverage
